messages:
deploy-bot: packaging-job 'airgap-vpc-2026.03' started for installer artifacts
packaging-bot: ERROR: checksum mismatch for image 'redwood/inference-installer:v2026.03.0'
packaging-bot: expected sha256:aaa111... got sha256:ccc333...
laura.h: seeing manifest checksum drift in staging, failing preflight. anyone else seeing repack activity last night?
mattb: @laura.h yep there was an ad-hoc repack by infra at 03:12 UTC, probably changed tar ordering. we should avoid emergency rebuild if possible.
laura.h: thoughts: pin to previous known-good image sha and re-run cosign sign, or rebuild deterministic tomorrow?
samir: Pin is faster. We need to ensure cosign signature validity. If content is different we must re-sign. Also will need to update release manifest and release-notes.
olivia: agree with pin+re-sign. Change window today 21:00-00:00 UTC. propose: pin -> re-sign -> canary to 2 customers -> full rollout if green.
laura.h: plan: 1) pin installer image to sha256:aaa111 2) re-run cosign with KMS 'release-key-1' 3) update /artifacts/manifest.json and publish checksums 4) notify security and customers
laura.h: cosign command (to run in packaging job):
```
cosign sign --key kms://projects/redwood/keys/release-key-1 \ 
  --annotations "build=airgap-vpc-2026.03" \ 
  redwood/inference-installer@sha256:aaa111
```
deploy-bot: rc created: tag=rc-2026-03-21-pin1 by laura.h
packaging-bot: re-run pipeline started on pinned image sha256:aaa111, build id=54321
mattb: I'll run preflight smoke after artifacts uploaded. @samir please stage a rollback tag that points to live v2026.02.5 sha256:bbb222 in case we flip.
samir: rollback tag ready -> tag: rollback-v2026.03-pin1 -> points at sha256:bbb222. Updated release-notes draft with note: "Pinned installer image due to checksum drift; deterministic rebuild scheduled."
packaging-bot: artifacts ready: installer.tar.gz sha256:ccc333, manifest.json sha256:ddd444, cosign signature present at s3://redwood-prod/artifacts/v2026.03.0-r1/signature.cosign
deploy-bot: CANARY deploy started to private customers [cust-a, cust-b] at 22:02 UTC (canary window 15m)
mattb: running smoke tests on cust-a and cust-b now. install success on both, basic inference test passed.
olivia: canary telemetry looks healthy (errors < 1%, latency within baseline). recommend proceed to full rollout at 23:00 UTC with 30m observe window.
oncall: oncall ack. I'll monitor metrics and be ready to flip to rollback tag if error rate > 5% sustained for 15m.
laura.h: pushing short release notes: "v2026.03.0-r1 — Private/VPC installer image pinned for packaging reproducibility; artifacts cosign-signed. Deterministic rebuild tracked in PR #4129."
deploy-bot: ROLLOUT full started at 23:05 UTC -> rollout id 9876
packaging-bot: packaging run 54321 closed: success. artifacts uploaded to s3://redwood-prod/artifacts/v2026.03.0-r1/
samir: filing follow-up: schedule deterministic tar ordering fix in build-tools and run a reproducibility test matrix. Created ticket PRJ-4129.
laura.h: :thumbsup: great coordination. I'll send customer note and update the private delivery checklist. Thanks everyone.
